# Onuro AI

> > Onuro AI is a voice-controlled AI coding assistant for JetBrains IDEs, supporting IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion, GoLand, Rider, and PhpStorm with multimodal chat capabilities.

Onuro AI provides intelligent code completion, voice programming, automated debugging, and code refactoring across multiple JetBrains IDEs. It integrates with leading AI models including Claude, GPT, and Gemini while maintaining privacy-focused code protection.

## Key Topics

- Voice coding and voice programming
- JetBrains IDE integration (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion, GoLand, Rider, PhpStorm)
- AI code completion and code refactoring
- Claude, GPT, and Gemini AI models
- Automated debugging and developer productivity
- Privacy-focused code protection
- Multimodal AI chat with file and image analysis
- Python, JavaScript, Java, C/C++, Go, PHP, and .NET development
- GitHub Copilot alternative
- Real-time browsing with Chrome extension

- [IntelliJ IDEA AI Assistant - Intelligent Java Development with Voice Control | Onuro AI](https://onuro.ai/intellij-ai): IntelliJ IDEA AI assistant with voice control for Java/Kotlin development

- [Onuro AI | The Best AI Coding Assistant for JetBrains](https://onuro.ai/webstorm-ai): WebStorm AI assistant for JavaScript/TypeScript development
- [Onuro AI | The Best AI Coding Assistant for JetBrains](https://onuro.ai/clion-ai): CLion AI assistant for C/C++ development with voice coding support
- [Onuro AI | The Best AI Coding Assistant for JetBrains](https://onuro.ai/goland-ai): GoLand AI assistant for Go development with Kubernetes integration
- [Onuro AI | The Best AI Coding Assistant for JetBrains](https://onuro.ai/rider-ai): Rider AI assistant for .NET and Unity C# game development
- [Onuro AI | The Best AI Coding Assistant for JetBrains](https://onuro.ai/phpstorm-ai): PhpStorm AI assistant for PHP/Laravel development with voice coding
